description: This file defines functions for parsing markdown content and transforming it into TypeScript test code, including handling fixtures, seed files, and test steps with annotations and tags.

methods.name: transformMDToTS
methods.description: Main function that parses markdown code and generates corresponding TypeScript test code with source maps.

methods.name: resolveFixtures
methods.description: Resolves fixture file paths relative to the current filename.

methods.name: escapeString
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in generated code.

methods.name: parsingError
methods.description: Creates an error object with context about parsing failures.

methods.name: asText
methods.description: Extracts text content from markdown nodes, with error handling.

methods.name: parseSpec
methods.description: Parses markdown content into a structured representation including description, tests, and properties.

methods.name: parseProp
methods.description: Parses a property list item into key-value pairs.

methods.name: parseTest
methods.description: Parses markdown nodes into a test object with title, lines, and properties.
